key_art.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original landscape 16:9 key art for ARC-SHIFT v2, preferably 1536 x 864, finished image only.
Primary request: an original hooded arcanist confronting a monumental ancient bronze guardian inside a dark astronomical ruined forge. Small ivory-hooded arcanist stands in the central-right foreground, face concealed in shadow, holding one sharply readable cyan crescent weapon. They face the much larger guardian in the right half of the composition.
Guardian design: a singular monumental construct, angular aged-bronze armor over ink-navy joints, broad ivory-edged shoulders, clear tapered wedge-shaped torso, two heavy legs and distinct feet, a dark narrow face, and one large thin circular bronze astronomical halo behind its head and shoulders. Restrained warm orange light in the face and chest seams. Original design, no recognizable characters from other games.
Scene/backdrop: a ruined astronomical forge with worn slate platforms, fragmented orbit engravings, restrained bronze celestial architecture, and distant shadowy structure.
Style/medium: highly authored hand-painted graphic illustration, expressive confident brushwork, striking simplified shapes, selective fine detail, premium fantasy game editorial key art. Matte pigment and paper-like texture, no glossy 3D render.
Composition/framing: panoramic 16:9 landscape. The entire left 40% is broad quiet deep-navy atmosphere with subtle large shadow shapes and very low detail, reserved for a title to be added later; do not put any text there. Main visual encounter occupies center-right and right side. Keep both figures visually distinct, make the arcanist small against the guardian's scale. Compose with architectural depth and an elegant powerful silhouette.
Color palette: muted ink navy, desaturated slate blue, warm ivory, aged copper and bronze. Cyan limited to the single crescent and tiny atmospheric echoes. Orange limited to restrained guardian embers. Dark overall, balanced contrast, no rainbow glow.
Lighting/mood: mysterious, poised tension, restrained cinematic light, ivory cloak and cyan crescent read clearly, bronze guardian emerges from darkness, no giant white flare.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no screenshot frame, no watermarks. No other-game characters. One small arcanist and one guardian only. No extra weapons, no additional figures. Do not turn the quiet left area into busy scenery.
key_art.visual_inspection: Original navy ruined astronomical forge, quiet left area, ivory arcanist with cyan crescent, monumental bronze halo guardian. No text or UI. Matte detailed illustration; somewhat more realistic and detailed than the requested simplified graphic direction.
